description:
Add a ContentProvider to the existing NotesApp to expose the Room database to other applications.

1. Create a contract class `NoteContract.kt` in `com.example.notesapp.provider` with:
   - AUTHORITY = "com.example.notesapp.provider"
   - CONTENT_URI
   - Column constants: COLUMN_ID, COLUMN_TITLE, COLUMN_CONTENT, COLUMN_TIMESTAMP

2. Create `NoteContentProvider.kt` in the same package:
   - Implement `onCreate`, `query`, `insert`, `update`, `delete`, `getType`
   - Use a `UriMatcher` to handle directory (code 1) and single item (code 2) URIs
   - Connect it to the existing `NoteDatabase`

3. Register the provider in `AndroidManifest.xml` with `exported="true"`.

4. Verify the project builds successfully using `./gradlew assembleDebug`.
